concept.title: A language model: a tireless reader
concept.shortdesc: A large language model reads one listing at a time and fills in a fixed form about it, quoting its evidence.

conbody.p: A large language model is software that has been trained on a very large amount of text. It can read a passage and answer questions about it in a structured way.
Here it acts as a patient clerk. It is given one listing at a time and a fixed form to fill in: what is offered, who it says it is for, any restrictions, and who provides it.
Two rules keep the clerk honest.

ul.li: It must restate what the listing says and not summarise it. Summaries smooth away detail, such as “supports wellbeing”.
Every answer taken from the text must come with the exact words quoted from the listing. An answer with no quotation is not accepted.

conbody.p: The model runs on a single powerful desktop computer belonging to the project. Listings are not sent to an outside service for this bulk reading.
